dehydrated_text:
The red group practices cannibalism during funerals, while the blue group buries bodies without such rituals. In 19th-century Victorian Britain, within the elite class, such practices were common. They would steal mummies from Egypt and eat them due to believing in their magical qualities.

Albert Einstein, before his death, requested that no one dissect his brain but a doctor did it anyway, cutting it into pieces. Suppose this doctor made medicine from Einstein's brain and sold it for a million dollars to rich people. Would 100 wealthy individuals pay such a sum to consume parts of Einstein's brain? Yes, they would.

My wife fears that my brain might be dissected after I die; please don't do so because my brain is no different from anyone else’s. The secret of my creativity cannot be found in my brain alone. 

The body functions as an integrated system where each part has its importance. Whether a part seems weak or strong, it is essential for the body's proper functioning. The eye does not need to dismiss the hand, nor can the foot ignore the arm. Each member must support one another.

When you consume the Body of Christ, you consume a part of Him. Thus, unity within the church requires mutual obedience and care. This means following others' directions to fully realize Jesus in our community. No matter your role, complete submission to Jesus is key.

Now you are the body of Christ, each an individual member. God has designated various roles: apostles, prophets, teachers, and so forth. Strive for greater gifts, as I will show you a more excellent path.
